# vgi-fred

FRED and ALFRED economic data through authenticated, typed, streaming SQL table functions. Use observations for current data; alfred_observations(series_id, as_of) for a historical snapshot; alfred_revisions for every revision interval; initial_releases for first published values; vintage_dates for publication/revision dates. Discover series through search_series, series, category, category_children, category_series, series_categories, releases, release_series, release_dates and sources. Supply a fred_api secret or FRED_API_KEY. Dates are daily, not intraday. Missing observation markers become NULL; value_text retains the original representation. Use named date bounds to reduce upstream work and max_rows for an explicit result cap.

Queries stream one API page at a time. Credentials stay out of continuation state. Read README.md for operational limits and examples.
